records.subject: Welcome aboard, Union Ventures
records.body:

Welcome! A lot of new teams ask us the same thing in the first few days: how do I get my team in here. Short answer -- a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Reply any time.

decisions.rationale: 6 days in with no first project, no invite, no key milestone, and zero replies to two outreach emails (email:f737178b, email:0bc78a59) and no tickets — no signal of engagement. Pro plan and 8 days left leave some chance of self-start, but silence dominates.

draft.subject: Getting Union Ventures started in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Kai,

Following up on my last note — no reply needed if things are moving, but I don't want you stuck on step one.

In Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so creating your first project is usually the easiest place to begin. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, and whenever you're ready, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a 15-minute call this week help? I'm happy to walk through your first project with you and answer anything else.

Best,
Chidi
